title: Health and Fitness Establishments
previewText: In M1 Districts paired with a Residence District, high-intensity uses, as listed in the definition of health and fitness establishments, shall be subject to the enclosure and environmental conditions for C7 Districts set forth in Section 32-16 (Use Group VI – Retail and Services), inclusive.
